header.running_head: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Files a Register for the Allowances Issued

blocks.text: knew the lineage of the Quraysh.

Hadhrat Umar (RA) gave the three men instructions to make a record of all the people according to their status. When they started writing the record, they commenced with the Banu Haashim (the family of Rasulullaah ﷺ). Thereafter, they recorded Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and his tribe, followed by Hadhrat Umar (RA) and his tribe. They did this to correspond with the sequence of the Khilaafah. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) looked at the register, he said "By Allaah! This is how I would have liked it to be. However, I want you to start with Rasulullaah ﷺ followed by all his relatives according to their closeness in relationship to him. You should then eventually place Umar wherever Allaah has had him placed."[^1]
The Incident Between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and the Banu Adi Tribe Concerning the Distribution of Wealth

Hadhrat Aslam reports that (after Hadhrat Umar (RA) opposed the view to place him and his tribe after Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and his tribe) the Banu Adi (the tribe of Hadhrat Umar (RA)) came to him and said, "You are the successor of Rasulullaah ﷺ." Hadhrat Umar (RA) corrected them saying, "Rather the successor of Abu Bakr (RA), because Abu Bakr (RA) was the successor of Rasulullaah ﷺ." They continued, "Whatever it may be. However, why do you rather not leave yourself where the three men have written it." Hadhrat Umar (RA) exclaimed, "Oh! Oh! Dear Banu Adi! Do you wish to get on my back and eat before other people, thereby destroying all my good deeds? I swear by Allaah that I shall never do so, (I shall start with relatives of Rasulullaah ﷺ) even though your names are written last. I have two companions who have walked a path and if I tread a different path, I shall not reach the destination. By Allaah! We have no honour in this world and cannot expect any of Allaah's rewards in the Aakhirah for our deeds without Muhammad ﷺ. He is the source of our honour and his tribe is the most honourable of all Arabs. The next in kin to him are then most honourable and then those closest in kinship after them. The Arabs have honour only because of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Perhaps the lineage of some of us meets us with his after many generations. Once the generations meet up, our lineage does not part from his until it reaches Aadam (AS) after a few more generations. Despite all of this (closeness to Rasulullaah ﷺ), if the non-Arabs arrive on the Day of Qiyaamah with plenty of good deeds and we arrive with none, they will be closer to Rasulullaah ﷺ than us. A person should therefore never look at his kinship and should carry out deeds for the rewards that Allaah holds. Verily, the one whose actions keep him lagging behind cannot be hurried along by his lineage."[^2]
Ibn Sa'd (Vol.3 Pg.212) and Tabari (Vol.5 Pg.22), as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.2 Pg.316).
Ibn Sa'd (Vol.3 Pg.212) and Tabari (Vol.3 Pg.278).
